property_summary: For all callers, calling setOwner on the correct contract only succeeds (completes without revert) when the caller is the admin; the mutant removes this restriction allowing non-admin callers to succeed, so there exist callers for which the mutant succeeds but the reference reverts.
change_summary: Alter the onlyAdmin modifier to allow anyone (no revert) so setOwner can be called by non-admins and still return its result; keeps behavior of setOwner's return value but changes caller permission which can affect observable outcome when caller differs.
